entities.summary: Ibrahim Nasrallah is a Jordan-born Palestinian poet and novelist. He received the Arabic Booker Prize (2018). Nasrallah was born in 1954 to Palestinian parents who were evicted from their land in Al-Burayj, Jerusalem in 1948.
